vetSays.line: 🛡️ Brianna, Rocco, Pieter, Yara and Owen met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Brianna, Rocco, Pieter, Yara, Owen are hurt.
🛡️ Pieter, Owen, Katarina and Jesse met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Pieter, Owen, Katarina, Jesse are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Sal, Yara, Jesse and Nathan met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Nathan didn't come back. Sal is hurt.
🛡️ Sal, Owen, Jesse and Maya met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Owen, Maya are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sal just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yara just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Brianna, Sal, Yara, Owen and Jesse met them at the door — 5 put down. Sal, Jesse are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Wei met them at the door — 1 put down. Wei is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Wei taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Wei is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Oliver and Wei met them at the door — 2 put down.
🛡️ Wei met them at the door — 1 put down.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Oliver: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
